summary: The focused double-release hypothesis does not require a harness update.

after.requirement: Avoid a second release of a terminal orphan comment during parser destruction.

assessment.comparison_reason: The same old harness parses once and conditionally destroys the parser. Neither version can release the terminal orphan comment twice through this path. Coverage remains incomplete because this packet asks for the focused candidate only.
